messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: prom_scrape_job_down (service: metrics-pipeline-prod) — urgency: high — runbook: metrics-scrape-failure. pagerduty link: https://pd.example/alerts/P12345

sam: ack'd. I'm the primary oncall, taking it. checking grafana/dashboards now — anyone seen spike? :eyes:

maria: seeing a ton of missing target labels in prometheus targets page, exporters returning 5xx. grabbing logs from exporter pods.

alex: also noticed log-ingest consumer lag on kafka-topic 'raw-logs' jumping. not sure if related but it's concurrent.

sam: paste the exporter pod status and logs please.

maria: pod status:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n metrics | egrep 'prometheus-exporter'
prometheus-exporter-1   1/1   CrashLoopBackOff   5   2m
prometheus-exporter-2   1/1   Running            0   45m
```
logs from exporter-1:
```
2026-03-14T02:17:12Z error failed to scrape target: 503 Service Unavailable
GET /metrics -> 503
runtime: upstream connection reset
```

sam: hm CrashLoopBackOff on exporter-1, but exporter-2 still up. looks like a rolling issue with one node. can we restart exporter-1?

maria: restarting now.

devops-bot: Running command: `kubectl delete pod prometheus-exporter-1 -n metrics`

maria: restarted and watching logs.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: this alert will autopage again if not acknowledged by escalation policy in 5m.

alex: kafka consumer lag for group 'ingest-raw-consumers' -> 123,400 messages behind across 6 partitions. `kafka-consumer-groups --describe` shows consumer 3 stuck.

sam: is ingestion backlog causing exporters to OOM or block? any JVM GC or thread dumps?

maria: exporter-1 logs after restart look normal now. prometheus targets page shows most up, but a subset of scrape jobs still show 0 samples — looks like job label mismatch from recent config change. I see config snippet error in configmap:
```
- job_name: 'app-metrics'
  static_configs:
    - targets: ['app-a:9100', 'app-b:9100']
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_service]
      regex: (.+)
      target_label: service
```
The label key changed last deploy to `service-name` so relabel fails -> targets appear but metrics missing.

sam: ah, recent rollout of infra-configs by platform team? @maria can you patch the configmap to use both keys while we roll back? Quick fix: add alternate relabel or copy label.

maria: applying quick patch to configmap to try both keys now.

devops-bot: `kubectl apply -f patched-prom-configmap.yaml` -> success. Reloading prometheus config.

sam: monitoring targets... grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/metrics/overview

maria: within 2 mins targets started populating for app-metrics job. exporter's crash was probably unrelated but amplified the symptom.

alex: kafka lag still high; ingestion consumers need scaling. I'll scale the deployment by 3 replicas.

alex: `kubectl scale deploy ingest-raw -n ingestion --replicas=8` -> scaling.

sam: good. customer impact check: any user-facing 5xx/latency spikes?

maria: quick sweep of API gateways show no elevated 5xx. internal metric dashboards for customers are stale for ~10-20m depending on tenant. Not an API outage, but telemetry/dashboards delayed.

sam: summary for incident ticket: Prometheus scrape drop due to relabel config mismatch introduced in last infra-config deploy; one exporter pod was CrashLoop which added noise. Kafka consumer lag concurrently spiked, causing log ingestion delay. Customer impact: dashboards stale, delayed telemetry ingestion; no API errors.

oncall-rotation: pinging night oncall @alex — handing off in 20m. please monitor consumer lag and prometheus targets.

sam: will keep monitoring for 30m post-fix before closing. tagging ops-runbook and incident ticket: https://tickets.example/INC-9876

pagerduty-bot: Alert resolved in PD (escalation cleared).

maria: rechecked exporter pods and prometheus targets — everything stable. kafka lag dropping to normal over last 10m.

alex: consumers rebalanced, lag down to ~1,200 and decreasing.

sam: thanks all. I'll leave a short post-incident note in postmortems channel after we confirm 1h of stability. :white_check_mark:

oncall-rotation: handed off to @alex (night) — monitoring ok.

sam: closing thread for now, will update incident ticket and link postmortem later. :slightly_smiling_face:
